'''Venkrol Anchor Boots''' is a piece of [[:Category:Equipment|Equipment]] Armor made for defending yourself against the parasites.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
The Venkrol Anchor Boots can be crafted using four [[Beckon Membrane|Beckon Membranes]] and Diamond Boots.
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Beckon Membrane|r1_a2=Beckon Membrane|r1_b2=Diamond Boots|r1_c2=Beckon Membrane|r1_b3=Beckon Membrane|r1_output=Venkrol Anchor Boots|r1_count=1}}

== ''Usage'' ==
 
These boots protect player from a [[Stage IV Beckon#Behavior|Stage IV Beckon's Vortex]]. When they are equipped, the Vortex will not throw the player away. They are also better than diamond boots stat-wise.
== ''Trivia'' ==

* Venkrol Anchor Boots share their name is the [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckon]], which is referred to internally as the Venkrol.
